name: The Taming of The Night Prince
source: There is only one way to save your father's restaurant: marry the most notorious playboy in LA. This last chance could turn your life around. Will you be able to tame the bad-tempered emperor of the night?
translation: 只有一种方法可以拯救你父亲的餐厅：嫁给洛杉矶最臭名昭著的花花公子。这最后的机会可能会改变你的生活。你能驯服脾气暴躁的夜皇吗？
